name: sure
description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
one_liner: A free, self-hosted budgeting and net-worth app — like Mint or YNAB, but you run it yourself and an AI assistant inside it answers questions about your own spending.
buyer: A privacy-conscious household or a small financial advisory practice that wants a budgeting tool without sending client bank data to a third-party SaaS.
business_use_cases: A household self-hosts it on a cheap VPS to track net worth and spending without a subscription to Mint/YNAB-style apps.
A small accounting or bookkeeping firm white-labels it as a free client perk, differentiating from competitors who only offer spreadsheets.
A financial advisor demos it to tech-savvy clients as a transparent, no-lock-in alternative to opaque bank apps.

money_ideas.idea: Run a managed-hosting service for people who want it without the self-hosting hassle, billed monthly
Offer paid setup/migration service helping people import years of bank data from their old finance app

steal_this: Spin up a one-click 'Sure, hosted' service this weekend — the app is free and open source, so the business is purely in handling hosting, backups, and bank-sync setup for people who don't want to run a server.
